candidates.how_to_measure: Not measured by C/D (their estimate). Governed or drag-limited is not stated for this car; C/D's 2022 Civic Touring sedan CVT was 'gov ltd' at 126 mph (different car, not used). Measure only on a closed course or read Honda's speed-limiter spec if one is ever published.
candidates.notes: Car and Driver estimate, not a measurement; whether a governor applies to the 6MT hatch is unknown. Range is the single printed estimate (n=1), not a tolerance.

candidates.notes: C/D reports the second-best of six stops, corrected to exactly 70.0 mph (method page).

perf.skidpad_g.description: Steady-state lateral grip on skidpad (C/D: usually 300-ft circle)

candidates.locator: Article body, paragraph beginning 'Stick shift or no'
candidates.evidence: We recorded an impressive 0.90 g of cornering grip on our skidpad, which would easily have been higher had the stability control not intervened.

applicability.notes: Car and Driver test car: 2022 Civic Sport Touring Hatchback, 6-speed manual, Sonic Gray paint, Continental ContiProContact 235/40R-18 91W M+S, C/D-measured curb weight 3024 lb. Same body/engine/gearbox as the 2024 target; model-year powertrain/chassis changes 2022->2024 to be confirmed by the identity thread (none known to this thread).

candidates.notes: Diameter not printed in this article; C/D method page: 'we usually use a 300-foot-diameter circle'. Stability control intervened, so this is an ESC-limited lower bound of tire/chassis grip. Not in the spec box.

tests.car: 2022 Honda Civic Sport Touring Hatchback, 6-speed manual, US, Sonic Gray (option $395)

excluded_tests.reason: Test car was a CVT ('This hatchback was an automatic model'); spec excludes CVT results. Figures (0-60 7.7 s, 1/4 15.9 s @ 89.8 mph, 60-0 117 ft, figure-eight 26.8 s @ 0.65 g) kept here only as context, not as targets.
